title: The Final Broadcast
narration: The radio presenter announced my disappearance while I was still driving home. A woman hiding in my boot claimed she was the real presenter and that an obsessed technician predicted crimes before committing them. At the station police arrested him using prerecorded voice samples. Then the woman entered the booth, locked the door and resumed the broadcast in her own voice. For several seconds I could hear nothing except my breathing and the small ordinary sounds around me. Every explanation I tried made the details worse, because each clue had been placed where I alone would find it. I wanted to leave immediately, but doing that would mean abandoning the only proof that any of this had happened. The technician had not stolen her programme; she had hired him to create the perfect alibi.
